data.one_liner: Fade and size transition between widgets or show/hide a widget.
data.what_it_does: Allows a fade and size transition when changing child widgets without needing to know their sizes in advance. Also provides a constructor to show and hide a widget by resizing it vertically while fading.
use_when: You want to animate both size and opacity when changing a child widget.
You want to show and hide a widget with a vertical resize and fade effect.
You do not know the exact sizes of the children in advance.
avoid_when: You only want to animate opacity without size changes.
You need complex physics-based motion or Rive/Lottie animations.
strengths: Simpler to use than AnimatedCrossFade when changing a single child dynamically.
No need to know child sizes in advance like AnimatedContainer.
Provides completion callbacks for fades and size changes.
weaknesses: Requires a Key to force cross-fading if replacing a widget of the same type with different parameters.
Fade and size transitions are vertically oriented for show/hide.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: For rich, chainable animation effects across multiple properties.
